meta.title: 停止怼脸化妆！方圆脸化妆就能开窍
meta.title_en: Stop Mirror-Cosmetic! Makeup That Flatters a Round-Square Face
meta.topic: 方圆脸化妆 · 他人视角的整体思路

scenes.title_en: Switch Cameras to See the Real Shape
scenes.context: 前置怼脸镜头下脸接近鹅蛋形，切到后置镜头才发现方圆脸外轮廓留白宽。
sentences: 前置怼脸镜头下接近标准鹅蛋脸。
Under the front camera close-up, the face looks close to an oval.
oval（鹅蛋形）
切换到后置镜头，外轮廓留白宽。
Switch to the rear camera and the outer contour shows wide negative space.
negative space（留白）
常规妆不适合方圆脸。
Regular makeup doesn't suit a round-square face.
round-square（方圆）
paraphrase: See your face the way other people do.
There's too much empty space around the face.
scenes.speak: Under the front camera close-up, the face looks close to an oval. Switch to the rear camera and the outer contour shows wide negative space. Regular makeup doesn't suit a round-square face.

scenes.title_en: Step Back and See the Whole
scenes.context: 退到镜子一臂半的距离看整体妆面，把脸想象成平面定眉尾。
sentences: 退到镜子一臂半的距离观察整体妆面。
Step back one and a half arms from the mirror to view the whole makeup.
one and a half arms（一臂半）
把脸想象成平面。
Imagine the face as a flat plane.
flat plane（平面）
取中间直线确定眉尾长度。
Use the center line to set the brow tail length.
brow tail（眉尾）
paraphrase: Look at the big picture, not just one feature.
Let the middle line guide where your brows end.
scenes.speak: Step back one and a half arms from the mirror to view the whole makeup. Imagine the face as a flat plane. Use the center line to set the brow tail length.

scenes.title_cn: 包裹感：眉毛只拉长一点
scenes.title_en: A Wrapped Feeling: Extend Brows Just a Little
scenes.context: 眉毛只拉长一点，整个脸就有被包裹住的感觉。
sentences: 眉毛只拉长一点。
Extend the brows just a little.
extend（拉长）
整个脸有被包裹住的感觉。
The whole face feels wrapped and contained.
wrapped（被包裹的）
不要贪长，微调幅度。
Don't go too long — make it subtle.
subtle（克制的）
paraphrase: Lengthen the brows slightly, nothing dramatic.
The face looks more held together.
scenes.speak: Extend the brows just a little. The whole face feels wrapped and contained. Don't go too long — make it subtle.

scenes.title_cn: 收缩脸型：腮红后移与三角区提亮
scenes.title_en: Slim the Shape: Move Blush Back and Brighten the Triangle
scenes.context: 腮红位置往后放用收缩色，眼影向外晕、三角区加深，形成平行四边形视觉收窄。
sentences: 腮红位置往后放，用收缩色。
Move the blush further back and use a shrinking shade.
shrinking shade（收缩色）
眼影往外侧晕。
Blend the eyeshadow outward.
blend outward（向外晕染）
外眼角到眉尾三角区加深。
Deepen the triangle from the outer eye to the brow tail.
triangle（三角区）
侧边形成平行四边形，视觉收窄。
The side forms a parallelogram that visually narrows the face.
parallelogram（平行四边形）
paraphrase: It makes the face look narrower than it is.
A receding color that pulls the face in.
scenes.speak: Move the blush further back and use a shrinking shade. Blend the eyeshadow outward. Deepen the triangle from the outer eye to the brow tail. The side forms a parallelogram that visually narrows the face.

practice: 怎么看清自己真实的脸型？
Use the rear camera or step back from the mirror.
方圆脸的眉毛要怎么处理？
Extend the brows just a little for a wrapped feel.
Move the blush back and use a shrinking shade.
Blend the eyeshadow outward toward the temples.
pitfalls: 用后置镜头看真实轮廓
自拍视角有欺骗性，会漏掉外轮廓留白。
过长显脸宽，包裹感消失。
外眼角到眉尾加深提亮
footer_notes: ASR 校正：转录中「怼脸/退到镜子」按画面语境修正。
